Alok Industries Q1FY21

As feared by Denofwealth, Alok has reported massive Loss for Q1FY21

On revenue of 373 Cr, Loss from operations is 574 Cr Vs 420 Cr QoQ Vs 67 cr YoY. After one time write off, Loss is unbelievably high at 10192 Cr

As on date, Alok Industries has accumulated Losses of 24546 Cr

We had been giving sell advice since 60 levels. We reiterate that despite Reliance/JM stake, Alok unlikely to report profit for FY21. JM is ARC and not promoter. ARC normally exits after lock in expires. For Mota Bhai, Alok is not even loose change. His focus Telecom and Retail. Reliance's own textile brand Vimal has witnessed huge decline
